conditions.name: Pituitary Neoplasm

ratingSchedule.note: No single behavior-neutral diagnostic code is assigned here; malignant endocrine neoplasms are evaluated under diagnostic code 7914 and benign endocrine neoplasms under diagnostic code 7915, with residual endocrine dysfunction evaluated as directed by the schedule.

reviewNotes: Pituitary neoplasm spans benign and malignant disease. The applicable diagnostic code depends on documented tumor behavior; do not assign one code without that information.
